useCases.title: Check credits before cleaning a list
useCases.text: Read the available Bouncify verification balance before planning an email check or bulk job.

useCases.title: Verify an email collected at signup
useCases.text: After confirming credit usage, check one email and review its verification result. Treat unknown and catch-all results as inconclusive.

useCases.title: Prepare an email list for verification
useCases.text: Confirm the upload of up to 1,000 addresses, then check when the stored list is ready. Verification starts through a separate confirmed action.

useCases.title: Run an approved bulk verification job
useCases.text: Confirm credit usage to start a ready list, then check progress and aggregate verification counts. Wait between status checks.
